correctness.rationale: PASS: Uniform even-sign coordinate permutations give E⟨gu,v⟩=0 and E⟨gu,v⟩²=1/d; for d>=4 odd third moments vanish. The nonnegative polynomial (b-X)(X+1/sqrt(d))² forces b>=1/sqrt(d) and equality X∈{±1/sqrt(d)}. Walsh orthogonality for d>=5 makes all pair products zero for a fixed permutation, hence axis-flat. At d=4 complementary Walsh characters permit the additional full-support flat-flat opposite-sign-product equality solutions. At d=3 (b-X)(1+X) forces b>=1/3, and equality yields a four-point tetrahedral orbit and flat-flat opposite parity. The rank-one norm is the increasing spectral expression (1+sqrt(5+4c))/2; it takes c=mu_d. Exhaustive independent even-signed-permutation orbit checks at d=3,4,5 verified all named extremal values and the d=5 nonextremal flat-flat witness; all-d equality classification relies on Walsh proof, not these finite tests.
